_comment: Asian board for the 2026-09-20 slate (Taipei 09-21). Twentieth slate of the prospective test, two thirds of the way. Twelve of the fifteen games on the US card; Phillies at Mets, Braves at Astros and Giants at Dodgers are on the card but not this board. No reading conflict. The board's own moneyline column appears in ten games and agrees with the market in all ten; the two without it, Tigers at White Sox and Yankees at Diamondbacks, both match my reading on the market alone at 0.5217 and 0.5097 respectively. Twins at Angels is worth noting after conflicting on each of the last two days: today the board prints its own moneyline column for that game, Minnesota 0.780 against the Angels 1.050, my row reading agrees, and the market agrees at 0.5217 to Minnesota. Three sources, one answer, first time in three attempts on this pairing. Handicaps flat at 0.950, totals flat at 0.940, no split prices.
